description: ClearExams daily current-affairs notes for 22 October 2026, covering India–Poland ties, postal revenue, Yamuna projects, parliamentary diplomacy, urban mobility, skills finance, maritime cooperation, precision medicine and Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0.

stories.title: India and Poland elevate bilateral ties to a Strategic Partnership
stories.summary: During the Polish Prime Minister’s official visit to India, the two countries issued a joint statement elevating their relationship to a Strategic Partnership. The step provides a higher-level framework for sustained political, economic and sectoral cooperation; implementation will depend on the agreed follow-up mechanisms and outcomes.
key_facts: The joint statement was issued on 22 October 2026 during the Polish Prime Minister’s visit to India.
The bilateral relationship was elevated to the level of a Strategic Partnership.
A strategic partnership is a broad diplomatic framework; individual projects and agreements still require implementation.
stories.exam_link: Revise India–Poland relations, Poland’s location in Central Europe, Warsaw as its capital, and the distinction between a joint statement, an MoU and a treaty.

stories.title: India Post crosses ₹4,000 crore revenue in two consecutive quarters
stories.summary: The Department of Posts reported revenue above ₹4,000 crore for two consecutive quarters for the first time. Revenue in the first half of FY 2026–27 reached ₹8,212.7 crore, up 24% from ₹6,636 crore a year earlier, with parcel services recording especially strong growth.
key_facts: First-half FY 2026–27 revenue was ₹8,212.7 crore, compared with ₹6,636 crore in the corresponding previous period.
The Department reported 24% year-on-year revenue growth in the first half.
Parcel revenue grew by 71%, while Postal Life Insurance and Rural Postal Life Insurance grew by 44%.
Nineteen of the 23 postal circles crossed 80% of their second-quarter targets.
stories.exam_link: Connect India Post with the Department of Posts under the Ministry of Communications and revise Postal Life Insurance, Rural Postal Life Insurance and the postal-circle administrative structure.
stories.source_title: India Post Creates History, Crosses ₹4,000 Crore Revenue Mark for Two Consecutive Quarters

stories.title: Delhi launches and approves ₹8,941.22 crore Yamuna rejuvenation package
stories.summary: A package of 43 Delhi Jal Board projects worth ₹8,941.22 crore was taken up for Yamuna rejuvenation and water-sector infrastructure. Ten projects worth ₹2,827.11 crore were inaugurated, while foundation stones were laid for 33 projects worth ₹6,114.11 crore; the latter are planned works, not completed assets.
key_facts: The package covers 43 projects of the Delhi Jal Board with a total value of ₹8,941.22 crore.
Ten completed projects worth ₹2,827.11 crore were inaugurated.
Foundation stones were laid for 33 projects worth ₹6,114.11 crore.
The Yamuna is a major tributary of the Ganga and flows through Delhi.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Yamuna’s source at Yamunotri, its course through the National Capital Territory, major tributaries, and the role of urban sewage treatment in river-pollution control.
stories.source_title: Union Home Minister attends inauguration and foundation-stone laying for Yamuna rejuvenation projects

stories.title: Registration opens for Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education announced Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 for 28 November–12 December 2026, with registration open until 13 November. The proposed programme will connect participants from Tamil Nadu with Varanasi, Prayagraj and Ayodhya around the theme of studying and sharing the Thirukkural.
key_facts: The fifth edition is scheduled from 28 November to 12 December 2026.
The theme is “Thirukkural Payilvom – Thirukkural Abhyas Karen”.
Around 1,400 participants are proposed in seven groups of about 200 each.
The programme locations are Varanasi, Prayagraj and Ayodhya.
The last date announced for registration is 13 November 2026.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Thirukkural and Tiruvalluvar, the cultural geography of Kashi, and the role of educational exchanges in strengthening links between Tamil Nadu and northern India.
stories.source_title: Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 to be organised from Nov 28 to Dec 12, 2026

stories.title: NSDC makes its debut on the NSE Social Stock Exchange
stories.summary: The National Skill Development Corporation marked its debut on the NSE Social Stock Exchange, signalling the use of regulated social-finance channels for skill-development and employment projects. The initiative is intended to support outcome-oriented financing; it does not by itself mean that every proposed project has already raised funds.
key_facts: The Social Stock Exchange is a regulated framework within India’s securities market ecosystem.
NSDC’s participation aims to develop innovative, outcome-oriented financing models for skilling.
NSDC works under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
Social Stock Exchange instruments seek to connect eligible social-purpose entities with impact-oriented capital.
stories.exam_link: Revise the National Skill Development Corporation, the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, SEBI’s regulatory role, and the purpose of India’s Social Stock Exchange.
stories.source_title: Union Minister marks NSDC’s debut on NSE Social Stock Exchange

stories.title: Indian Navy’s First Training Squadron arrives in Maldives
stories.summary: Ships of the Indian Navy’s First Training Squadron—INS Tir, INS Sujata and Indian Coast Guard Ship Sarathi—arrived off Malé during a long-range training deployment. The visit combines sea training with professional interaction and supports India–Maldives maritime cooperation in the Indian Ocean.
key_facts: The participating vessels named in the release are INS Tir, INS Sujata and ICGS Sarathi.
The squadron arrived off Malé as part of a long-range training deployment.
The First Training Squadron is associated with training sea officers and strengthening professional naval exchanges.
Malé is the capital of Maldives, an Indian Ocean archipelagic state.
stories.exam_link: Revise India’s maritime neighbourhood, the difference between the Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard, the strategic location of Maldives, and the concept of maritime domain awareness.
stories.source_title: First Training Squadron Arrives in Maldives

stories.title: India announces hosting of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum
stories.summary: The Parliament of India announced that it will host the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum on 26–27 October 2026 in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan. The planned forum will bring together parliamentary delegations to discuss cooperation and people-centric development; the announcement precedes the event itself.
key_facts: The forum is scheduled for 26 and 27 October 2026.
The principal venue announced is the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan in New Delhi.
The forum’s theme is “Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development”.
A parliamentary forum complements, but is institutionally distinct from, meetings of BRICS heads of state and government.
stories.exam_link: Revise BRICS, parliamentary diplomacy, the constitutional role of Parliament in India, and the renaming of the old Parliament House as Samvidhan Sadan.
stories.source_title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum to be Held in Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan

stories.title: Bhubaneswar to host 19th Urban Mobility India Conference
stories.summary: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs announced that the 19th Urban Mobility India Conference and Exhibition will be held in Bhubaneswar on 23–24 October 2026. A separate National Urban Conclave is planned for 24–25 October, with the events intended to convene policymakers, experts and urban stakeholders.
key_facts: The Urban Mobility India Conference is scheduled for 23–24 October 2026 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Its theme is “Urban Accessibility and Liveability in Digital Age”.
The second National Urban Conclave is scheduled for 24–25 October 2026.
The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is organising the events with support from the Government of Odisha.
stories.exam_link: Revise sustainable urban transport, transit-oriented development, universal accessibility, urban local bodies and the responsibilities of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
stories.source_title: MoHUA to organise 19th Urban Mobility India Conference and Exhibition

stories.title: Precision medicine highlighted at SRIHER convocation in Chennai
stories.summary: At the SRIHER convocation in Chennai, the Union Science and Technology Minister highlighted the emerging convergence of artificial intelligence, genomics and precision medicine. The address stressed translating scientific advances into clinical outcomes and expanding research engagement; it was a policy and scientific outlook, not the launch of a new treatment programme.
key_facts: The address linked artificial intelligence and gene-based information with precision medicine.
Precision medicine tailors prevention or treatment using individual biological and clinical variation.
The event was held at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research in Chennai.
The address emphasised converting research advances into measurable clinical outcomes.
stories.exam_link: Revise genomics, biomarkers, artificial intelligence in healthcare, personalised or precision medicine, and the ethical importance of privacy and informed consent in genomic data use.
stories.source_title: AI-Guided, Gene-Driven Precision Medicine highlighted at SRIHER Convocation

mcqs.question: On 22 October 2026, India and which country elevated their bilateral relationship to a Strategic Partnership?
mcqs.explanation: The India–Poland joint statement announced the elevation of bilateral ties to a Strategic Partnership.

mcqs.question: India Post’s revenue in the first half of FY 2026–27 was reported at approximately:
mcqs.explanation: The Department of Posts reported ₹8,212.7 crore, 24% above the corresponding ₹6,636 crore.

mcqs.question: Which India Post business segment recorded 71% growth in the reported first-half results?
mcqs.explanation: The official release identified parcel revenue as growing by 71%.

mcqs.question: How many Delhi Jal Board projects were included in the ₹8,941.22 crore Yamuna-related package?
mcqs.explanation: The package comprised 43 projects: 10 inaugurated and 33 for which foundation stones were laid.

mcqs.question: The 2026 theme of Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 centres on the study of which classical work?
mcqs.explanation: The announced theme is “Thirukkural Payilvom – Thirukkural Abhyas Karen”.

mcqs.question: Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 is scheduled to be held during which period?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Education scheduled the fifth edition from 28 November to 12 December 2026.

mcqs.question: The Social Stock Exchange on which NSDC marked its debut operates within which regulatory ecosystem?
mcqs.explanation: India’s Social Stock Exchange operates within the securities-market framework regulated by SEBI.

mcqs.question: Which of the following vessels was part of the First Training Squadron group reported off Malé?
mcqs.explanation: The reported group included INS Tir, INS Sujata and Indian Coast Guard Ship Sarathi.

mcqs.question: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum was announced for which venue?
mcqs.explanation: Parliament announced the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan as the principal venue.

mcqs.question: What is the announced theme of the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum?
options: One Earth, One Family, One Future
mcqs.explanation: The forum’s theme is “Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development”.

mcqs.question: The 19th Urban Mobility India Conference and Exhibition is scheduled in which city?
mcqs.explanation: MoHUA announced Bhubaneswar, Odisha, as the host city for 23–24 October 2026.

mcqs.question: Which phrase best describes precision medicine?
options: Treatment guided by individual biological and clinical variation
Replacement of diagnosis with population averages
mcqs.explanation: Precision medicine uses individual variation—such as genomic, environmental and clinical information—to guide prevention or treatment.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes the Yamuna project announcements?
options: Ten projects were inaugurated and 33 received foundation stones
mcqs.explanation: Ten projects were inaugurated; foundation stones marked planned or commencing work for the other 33.

mcqs.question: Malé, visited by the First Training Squadron, is the capital of:
mcqs.explanation: Malé is the capital of Maldives, an archipelagic country in the Indian Ocean.

mcqs.question: The 19th Urban Mobility India Conference is organised by which Union ministry?
options: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs is organising the conference with support from the Government of Odisha.
